segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, quick sanity check on Henderson Manufacturing. They want 72 seats, plus the audit logging add-on, go-live August 19. I quoted $48,600 annual, net 30, standard MSA.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay. Is this the one where procurement asked for the two-year option too?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. One-year at $48,600, two-year at $92,400 with the 5% uplift waived in year two. I’m trying to get the proposal out today because their CFO is only reviewing on Thursday.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Makes sense. Any approval needed from deal desk?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That’s the part that’s killing me. To produce one clean proposal, I have to enter the same customer name, seat count, billing contact, start date, discount, and SKU list in the CRM, then again in the pricing sheet, then again in the proposal builder, then again in the billing tool draft, and then deal desk wants it pasted into their intake form. If legal changes one term, I have to go back through all five places and retype it so the numbers match. I started this at 9:15, and it’s almost 1:00, and I still don’t have a PDF I can send. Last month the same thing stretched into two days for a renewal because the address was different in one system.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Ugh, yeah. For Henderson, use the Dallas billing address from the signed order form, not the headquarters address in the account notes. That mismatch caused the invoice kickback on Lakeside.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Good catch. Billing contact is Priya Nair, AP shared inbox copied, PO required over $25,000. They said PO can arrive after signature as long as it’s before first invoice.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Then I’d put the subscription start as September 1, even if go-live is August 19. Cleaner for invoicing.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Agreed. I’ll send the one-year and two-year options in the same proposal and call out that implementation is included, not a separate line item.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Perfect. If deal desk pushes back on the two-year discount, tell them it’s tied to signature by July 31. That usually gets it through.
